notes: The VP-V Config section's data table (owner 2026-10-24: one VP-V master section, sub-pages per unit, global tier + 'Fallbacks engaged').
tools/gen_vpv_tiers.py turns this file + slots.json into src/VideoProcessor-Config/vpv/VpvTierTable.generated.h; '--check' fails when the header is stale or a slot/key reference is wrong.

Tier keys live in the RENDERER PROFILE section (vprenderer / vprenderer.<name>); no new renderer key stores a tier: the tier is read back from the key values (slider scheme: keep the underlying keys).

A unit lists only the tiers it can really distinguish today (owner: fewer tiers where a unit lacks the granularity). The global tier maps to each unit's highest listed tier at or below it; 'planned_tiers' are shown as 'not yet implemented'.

'set' keys define AND write a tier. 'on_enter' keys are written only when the current value equals 'from' (e.g. leaving Classic restores the default motion taste); they never decide which tier is shown.
'taste' keys (the motion slider) are never greyed in upstream pages; 'managed' keys are greyed there with 'managed by VP-V' while the VP-V pathway is on.
Defaults are the renderer's built-in values when the key is absent (LibplaceboVideoRenderer / RendererProfileConfig parsers, checked 2026-10-24).

Coverage audit 2026-10-24 (docs/settings/coverage-audit.md): toggles added for VP's own per-profile keys that had a control only on the Rendering page; 'more_settings' names where the rest of a unit's settings are; 'proposed_retirement' lists the guide's section-12 candidates, shown on the VP-V page and marked on their upstream controls (visible, never removed) until the owner approves.

vpv_section.note: [vpv] holds VP-V's global (not per-profile) keys; the renderer reads them there first (then [vprenderer], the skeleton's original place). pipeline_original_pathway on = the Original pathway (every VP addition off, ADR-0019); absent/off = the VP-V pathway.

delay.note: Owner 2026-10-24: ONE total delay, the same at every frame rate (padded); 4 queued frames recommended (about 267 ms at 23.976 on 60 Hz, measured; the owner's estimate was 250); lower settings fall back to 3/2 frames with every feature still working.

units.name: Input
units.summary: Takes the picture from the capture card at full precision, works out the signal type and holds it for the fixed delay.
units.untiered_reason: Always on: capture and timing have no quality steps, only paths (the toggles below).

toggles.label: Source range (when the source mislabels it)
Content labels for profile rules (film / video / sports)

units.more_settings: Total delay and queue profiles: Queue page. Signal detection (DV tunnel hand-off, new LLDV): DV page. Capture card and packing: General page.

units.name: Motion
units.summary: Measures motion once on the untouched picture and feeds the de-judder, hiccup repair and dither.

Classic.description: VP's basic motion search only: whole-pixel matching, no NVIDIA engine, nothing computed ahead. Your de-judder amount still applies (choose As shot for no motion processing).

Low.description: VP's own motion search at quarter-pixel precision (no NVIDIA engine, nothing computed ahead).

Mid.description: NVIDIA optical-flow engine plus VP's matcher, vectors computed 4 frames ahead (the default motion engine).

Upper.description: As Mid, and poorly matched blocks are searched again as quarter blocks (small objects on moving backgrounds get their own motion).

toggles.label: Where motion is not trusted: hold or blend
Ease the de-judder per shot (only ever lower)

units.more_settings: Smooth motion (libplacebo) vs VP's de-judder, and deinterlacing: VP Renderer > Motion. Everything else of this unit is on Main and Advanced here.

units.name: Repair
units.summary: Cleans streaming damage at the picture's real size: encoding repair (planned), deband, breathing and texture restore.

Classic.description: No VP repair: libplacebo's own deband only, no breathing reduction, no texture restore.

Low.description: libplacebo deband plus the breathing reduction (detail pulse stabilise): today's defaults.

Mid.description: VP's grain-safe debander replaces libplacebo's, plus the breathing reduction.

Upper.description: As Mid, plus texture restore (fine texture the stream smeared, held along the motion). Expensive until its efficiency pass.

planned.label: Encoding repair (net A or VP restore)

units.more_settings: libplacebo's own debander (Deband strength): VP Renderer > Rendering > Processing.

units.name: Scaling
units.summary: Undoes the player's upscale (re-base), brings the picture to 4K and scales it to the projector.

planned_tiers.Upper: the 4K refine net and the D refine add-on are not built yet

Classic.description: Straight to the projector size with classical scaling: no re-base, no SSIM blend.

Low.description: Re-base: a picture upscaled before VP is worked from its real size; plain scaling to the projector size. The shipped default.

Mid.description: Re-base, then VP's grain-true downscale blend (weight 0.2) to the projector size.

toggles.label: Re-base ignores the player's own subtitles
Never re-base a mixed screen (menu, picture-in-picture)
Steady the downscaler's added detail along motion
Steady the upscaler's added detail along motion

planned.label: D refine add-on under the hybrid scaler

units.more_settings: The upscaler, downscaler and chroma filters (libplacebo): VP Renderer > Scaling.

units.name: Colour
units.summary: libplacebo tone and gamut mapping, below-black/above-white kept, SDR tone shape, Stage 13 appearance (planned).
units.untiered_reason: libplacebo does the colour in every tier; the cheaper combined HDR->SDR LUT for Classic/Low is not yet implemented.

toggles.label: Dolby Vision trims for your display
Full precision for every tier (32-bit float intermediates)

units.more_settings: Tone mapping, HDR target, gamut and output gamma: VP Renderer > Rendering and Color / Output. The calibration LUT file: Color / Output.

units.name: Dynamic Drive
units.summary: Projector LED and contrast control from the picture: measurement, compensation, black level (planned).
units.untiered_reason: Not a quality/cost choice: Dynamic Drive is set up on its own page (projector, script/compensate).
units.more_settings: Everything Dynamic Drive does is set on the Dynamic Drive page: the projector connection, the command source (script / compensate / none), the LED and contrast tuning and its fixes under test.

units.name: Output
units.summary: The calibration LUT, the dither for the 8-bit link and the presentation.

planned_tiers.Upper: there is no extra output step yet

Low.description: As shipped: the shader list decides the dither (the cinema list uses VP's own motion-aware dither).

Mid.description: Always VP's own motion-aware dither: the finest steps through the 8-bit projector link.

toggles.label: Dither: no smear where new picture appears

units.more_settings: Display bit depth and libplacebo's dithering: VP Renderer > Rendering > Processing. Where the calibration LUT runs: the Pipeline (expert) tab.
